column3: The Board shall consist of-

(a)
the following ex-officio members, namely-

(i)
the  Secretary  to  the  Ministry  of  the
Minister  assigned  the  subject  of
Finance or his representative being an
officer not below the rank of Additional
Secretary;

(ii)
the  Secretary  to  the  Ministry  of  the
Minister  assigned  the  subject  of

Southern 
Development 
or 
his
representative  being  an  officer  not
below the rank of Additional Secretary;

(iii)
the  Chairman  of  the  Sri  Lanka  Ports
Authority  established  under  section  3
of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act,
No. 51 of 1979 or a Director nominated
by him among the Directors appointed
under section 5 (1) (a) of the above said
Act; and

(iv)
the  Chairman  of 
the  Board  of
Investment  of  Sri  Lanka  established
under  section  6  of  the  Board  of
Investment Law, No. 4 of 1978;
